# Vicky's Hair Salon

> Hair salon based in Austin, Texas. Vicky and her team take the time to study your hair, suggest the right cut and color, and send you out loving it, at neighborhood-salon prices.

- Phone: (512) 796-0671
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Yelp rating: 4.8 from 16 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://sitelift.app/beauty/vickys-hair-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://sitelift.app/beauty/vickys-hair-salon/book.html

## Services
- Women's cuts: Cuts shaped to your hair type, from long trims to fresh new styles.
- Color & highlights: Dimensional color, balayage and grey coverage, planned with you.
- Men's & kids' cuts: Clean fades and designs for men and boys, and patient kids' cuts.
- Styling & treatments: Curls, updos and deep conditioning for healthy hair.

## About
Vicky's Hair Salon is a locally owned salon on Manchaca Road. Vicky, Crystal, Melissa and the team cut and color for women, men and kids, from a first trim to a full color change. Clients describe stylists who really listen and come up with ideas for new cuts and color. Families book the whole family in for back-to-school cuts, and newcomers to South Austin say they found their go-to salon here.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment at Vicky's Hair Salon?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (512) 796-0671 or book online and Vicky's will confirm by text.
- Q: Where is Vicky's Hair Salon?
  A: 11200 Manchaca Rd, Bldg 4, Unit 3, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: Do you cut and color all hair types?
  A: Yes. Women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, highlights and styling for every hair type.
- Q: Can I bring inspiration photos?
  A: Please do. Photos help your stylist match the cut or color you have in mind.
- Q: What do clients say about Vicky's?
  A: Vicky's Hair Salon is rated 4.8 stars from 16 Yelp reviews. Clients mention stylists who really listen, great color advice and fair prices.
